name: quark-create-shapeshifter-pass
description: Author a new ShapeShifter graph-transformation pass for AMD Quark (ONNX or PyTorch). Trigger for "add a ShapeShifter pass", "create a new onnx_ or pytorch_ pass", "write a custom Quark graph transform", "contribute a community ShapeShifter pass", or extending quark/shapeshifter/passes/. Covers naming, subclassing ONNXPass/PytorchPass with @register_pass, implementing _default_config and _run_for_config, the test, and the docs entry. Developer-facing authoring tool, not an end-user quantization step.
